implementation.name: original-v1-rnn-state-lifetime
implementation.scope: The figure's three drawn steps as a toy complete sequence (T = 3) from a zero initial state, with the caption's 128-wide hidden state and 100-wide input. Per-step MACs (16,384 recurrent + 12,800 input) come from RNNCompute (MLSysIM Scenarios.ElmanRnnStep). Counts are hidden states held after each step completes (the chapter's h_1 ... h_T); inputs, outputs, and backward work are not counted. The 1,000-step comparison uses the same scenario. Motion is illustrative, not time.
implementation.question: Why does training keep every state that inference frees?

purpose: Follow the same three unrolled hidden states through streaming inference and then BPTT: inference keeps one state and frees its predecessor after the last read; training keeps all three through the forward pass and frees them right to left only after each one's backward step. Each recurrent step waits for the state before it, while the input projections can run ahead.
storyboard: Inference: shared weights exist once each; no hidden state yet; no input arrived.
Inference step t-1: read the zero initial state and x_{t-1}; write h_{t-1} (16,384 + 12,800 = 29,184 MACs); 128 values kept.
Inference step t: read h_{t-1} through the same W_hh, write h_t, free h_{t-1}; still 128 values.
Inference step t+1: write h_{t+1}, free h_t; 128 values after 3 x 16,384 = 49,152 recurrent MACs in order.
Training: whole sequence known; three input projections (3 x 12,800 = 38,400 MACs) run ahead; h_t and h_{t+1} wait.
Training forward t-1: write and keep h_{t-1}; 128 values.
Training forward t: keep h_{t-1} for backward; 256 values.
Training forward t+1: all three kept; 384-value peak; forward work equal to inference (87,552 MACs).
Backward through t+1: gradient enters from y_{t+1}; free h_{t+1}; 256 values.
Backward through t: gradient moves back through W_hh (Jacobian product); free h_t; 128 values.
Backward through t-1: free h_{t-1}; one gradient per shared matrix; 0 values.
Compare: inference 128 values at any T; BPTT 384 at toy T = 3 and 128,000 values (512,000 bytes FP32) at the scenario's 1,000 steps; recomputation trades work for memory.
guard: Same circles, labels, arrows, colors, and compact loop as the TikZ source; badges sit beside nodes and never cover a label. A state is freed only after its last reader: inference after the next forward step, BPTT after its own backward step, right to left. No byte size except the MLSysIM scenario's FP32 state; no LSTM gates, truncated BPTT, checkpointing quantity, backward MAC count, or latency claim. Motion is not time.
